title.en: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
title.zh: 优步推出英国首款带司机的机器人出租车——乘坐体验如何

summary.en: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
summary.zh: 网约车应用已推出15辆自动驾驶出租车，但车内配有安全员。

body.en:
Londoners are able to hail the UK's first robotaxis - as Uber today becomes the first company to launch a self-driving minicab.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

Uber said it surveyed London-based customers via the app and more than 100,000 said they would choose a self-driving taxi if one was available, despite incidents of driverless rides malfunctioning in US cities where they already operate.

As I found out when I became the first UK journalist to hail one, it was mostly smooth but the safety driver did intervene on one occasion.

At the moment the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

Taking a self-driving ride will only appear as an option in the app after the journey has been booked, and if one of its cars is available nearby.

Uber's global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia said the plan was to phase them in over a period of several years.

"We always want consumers to be able to request a human ride or an autonomous vehicle, and because the market's growing, we expect that there will be human drivers on Uber London for a long time to come," he said.

The Ford Mustang electric vehicles which make up Uber's current small fleet are fitted with the UK tech firm Wayve's driverless car technology, which uses AI to analyse data about what is going on around it in real time, gathered by sensors in a bar on the roof of the vehicle and elsewhere.

The vehicles are not pre-programmed - their actions are determined on the spot depending on what is going on.

Google's autonomous car company Waymo and the Chinese tech giant Baidu are also vying to launch services in the UK, and the competition is fierce.

Wayve chief executive Alex Kendall described developing the technology as "the space race for our generation" but added there were some "really hard problems to solve" along the way.

"What we've done over time is pioneer a completely new approach to autonomous driving, making it possible to bring this to a busy and complex city like London and scale it globally," he said.

This week I became the first British journalist to travel as a customer in a self-driving Uber after hailing one via the app.

The safety driver gave me a 30-second safety briefing, and then we were off, making our way down the busy streets of central London.

For several minutes, we negotiated the traffic without incident, cruising past a busy Brexit demonstration under way outside parliament, successfully navigating traffic lights and roadworks along the way.

When a cyclist paused and waved...
body.zh: 伦敦人可以欢呼英国第一辆机器人出租车——优步今天成为第一家推出自动驾驶小型出租车的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 Uber 表示，它通过该应用程序对伦敦的客户进行了调查，超过 10 万名客户表示，如果有自动驾驶出租车，他们会选择自动驾驶出租车，尽管他们已经在美国城市运营的无人驾驶出租车出现了故障。 当我成为第一个向安全司机欢呼的英国记者时发现，一切都很顺利，但安全司机确实有一次进行了干预。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 只有在预订行程后，并且附近有一辆自驾车辆可用时，乘坐自驾游才会作为一个选项出现在应用程序中。 Uber 自动驾驶移动和配送全球主管 Sarfraz Maredia 表示，该计划将在几年内分阶段实施。 他说：“我们一直希望消费者能够要求有人乘坐或自动驾驶汽车，而且由于市场不断增长，我们预计 Uber London 将在未来很长一段时间内有人类司机。” 构成 Uber 目前小型车队的福特野马电动汽车配备了英国科技公司 Wayve 的无人驾驶汽车技术，该技术使用人工智能来实时分析周围发生的情况的数据，这些数据由车辆顶部酒吧和其他地方的传感器收集。 这些车辆没有预先编程——它们的行动是根据发生的情况当场决定的。 谷歌旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo和中国科技巨头百度也竞相在英国推出服务，竞争非常激烈。 Wayve 首席执行官亚历克斯·肯德尔 (Alex Kendall) 将开发这项技术描述为“我们这一代人的太空竞赛”，但他补充说，在此过程中存在一些“真正难以解决的问题”。 他说：“随着时间的推移，我们所做的是开创一种全新的自动驾驶方法，使其能够将其引入伦敦这样繁忙而复杂的城市，并在全球范围内推广。” 本周，我通过应用程序叫了一辆自动驾驶优步车，成为第一位乘坐自动驾驶优步车出行的英国记者。 安全司机给我做了 30 秒的安全简报，然后我们就出发了，沿着伦敦市中心繁忙的街道行驶。 在几分钟的时间里，我们顺利通过了交通，驶过议会外正在进行的繁忙的脱欧示威活动，成功地通过了沿途的红绿灯和道路施工。 当一个骑自行车的人停下来挥手时......

reflection.en: Uber's introduction of robotaxis in London, even with safety drivers, marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle technology. As this new venture unfolds, the company and its employees might consider committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and safety in this innovative endeavor. May their work be guided by...
reflection.zh: 优步在伦敦推出机器人出租车，即使配备安全员，也标志着自动驾驶技术的重要一步。随着这项新事业的展开，公司及其员工或许会考虑将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期在这项创新事业中取得成功和安全。愿他们的工作以智慧为指导，并致力于为公众提供良好服务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Spending deal comes with a bonus: Blocking political control of grants
title.zh: 支出协议附带一项奖励：阻止对资助的政治控制

summary.en: Congress pauses the OMB's attempt to rewrite how research is funded.
summary.zh: 国会暂停了行政管理和预算局（OMB）试图改写研究资助方式的举动。

body.en: On Tuesday, the House of Representatives passed a stopgap measure that would continue funding the US government through early December. While the measure still requires the signature of President Trump, it's widely expected that he will act to avoid a government shutdown immediately before the midterm elections. This is a normal part of how the US government has operated in recent years, as it's often difficult to build the political support needed to pass a full year's budget in advance. In fact, dissent within the House's Republican caucus prevented them from agreeing on their own measure to keep the government open; instead, the House simply adopted a version of the spending bill that had previously passed the Senate. From the perspective of scientists and their supporters, that adoption turned out to be a very good thing, because the Senate's budget bill, passed in early August , contains a provision that blocks the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) from implementing new rules that would give political appointees full control over what science is funded and allow them to cancel any grant at any time. The proposed rule has been widely decried as catastrophic for science, and it faced widespread opposition from scientific and health-focused organizations. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 周二，众议院通过了一项权宜之计，将继续为美国政府提供资金直至 12 月初。尽管该措施仍需要特朗普总统签署，但人们普遍预计他将在中期选举前采取行动避免政府关门。这是美国政府近年来运作方式的正常部分，因为通常很难获得提前通过全年预算所需的政治支持。事实上，众议院共和党核心小组内部的异议使他们无法就自己保持政府开放的措施达成一致。相反，众议院只是通过了参议院之前通过的支出法案的一个版本。从科学家及其支持者的角度来看，这种采用是一件非常好的事情。因为八月初通过的参议院预算法案包含一项条款，禁止管理和预算办公室 (OMB) 实施新规则，让政治任命者完全控制科学资助项目，并允许他们随时取消任何资助。拟议的规则被广泛谴责为科学灾难，并遭到科学和健康组织的广泛反对。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the midst of complex legislative maneuvering, Congress has stepped in to halt the Office of Management and Budget's proposed changes to research funding. This pause, driven by a desire to prevent political interference in scientific inquiry, reflects a commitment to principles of fairness and accountability in governance. It reminds us that the pursuit...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的立法博弈中，国会介入阻止了行政管理和预算局（OMB）提出的研究资助方式的改变。这一暂停，源于防止政治干预科学研究的愿望，体现了对公共治理中公平和问责原则的承诺。它提醒我们，在公共生活中追求正义和诚信是一项持续的努力。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: I rented a car, and within hours, my driver's license was for sale
title.zh: 我租了一辆车，几个小时后，我的驾照就被拿去卖了

summary.en: The FBI is reportedly investigating a massive data breach that is unfolding in real time, where a driver's license scanned by a rental car company employee was found for sale on the dark web.
summary.zh: 据报道，联邦调查局正在调查一起大规模数据泄露事件，该事件正在实时发生。一家租车公司员工扫描的驾照出现在暗网上出售。

body.en: Not long ago, I rented an SUV from a well-known car rental company. Within hours of an employee scanning my driver's license, a high-resolution scan of my ID was available for sale on the dark web. An exposé published Tuesday by KrebsOnSecurity reports that my license was one of more than 153 million that were available through Nexus, the name of the new ID theft service. Like other driver's licenses available there—including some belonging to journalist Brian Krebs, his mother, an FBI assistant director, and several security researchers—my license was purported to include multiple image files showing both the front and back of the ID. Besides a basic image scan, the files also captured the images in the infrared and ultraviolet spectrums. Presumably, the additional formats may allow cloned-based counterfeit IDs to pass hologram tests. Growing by the day Besides advertising the availability of driver's licenses, Nexus offered to sell a bevy of other forms of ID. They included: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 不久前，我从一家知名汽车租赁公司租了一辆SUV。在一名员工扫描我的驾驶执照后几个小时内，我身份证的高分辨率扫描件就可以在暗网上出售。 KrebsOnSecurity 周二发布的一份报告称，我的许可证是通过 Nexus（新的身份盗窃服务的名称）获得的超过 1.53 亿个许可证之一。与那里提供的其他驾照一样，其中一些驾照属于记者布莱恩·克雷布斯、他的母亲、联邦调查局助理局长和几名安全研究人员，我的驾照据称包含多个显示身份证正面和背面的图像文件。除了基本图像扫描之外，这些文件还捕获了红外和紫外光谱中的图像。据推测，附加格式可能允许基于克隆的伪造 ID 通过全息图测试。与日俱增 除了宣传驾驶执照的可用性之外，Nexus 还出售一系列其他形式的身份证件。其中包括： 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: It is deeply unsettling to learn that a simple act like renting a car can lead to one's identity being compromised and sold. This incident underscores how the pursuit of illicit profit can drive individuals to exploit the personal information of others, turning trust into a commodity for sale on the dark web.
reflection.zh: 得知像租车这样简单的行为会导致个人身份信息被泄露和出售，这令人深感不安。这一事件凸显了对非法利润的追逐如何驱使个人剥削他人的个人信息，将信任变成了暗网上待售的商品。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: FCC plans robocall scorecard to grade phone companies on spam call blocking
title.zh: FCC 计划推出机器人电话记分卡，以评估电话公司屏蔽垃圾电话的效果

summary.en: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has announced plans to develop a scorecard system to evaluate the effectiveness of phone companies in blocking illegal spam calls. These scorecards may incorporate data on call-blocking rates, customer complaints, and enforcement actions, potentially assigning providers risk...
summary.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）宣布计划开发一个记分卡系统，以评估电话公司在阻止非法垃圾电话方面的有效性。这些记分卡可能会纳入通话阻止率、客户投诉和执法行动的数据，并可能为提供商分配风险分类或等级。

body.en: The Federal Communications Commission today said it will create a robocall mitigation scorecard to rate phone companies on how effectively they block illegal spam calls. The scorecards could include call-blocking statistics along with data on customer complaints and enforcement actions. The FCC said scorecards could grade providers on a number scale, with letter grades, or by classifying providers as low risk, medium risk, or high risk. "The Scorecard will empower consumers and encourage providers to continue to combat illegal robocalls by providing the public with an assessment of the effectiveness of voice service providers’ efforts to protect consumers from illegal robocalls," the FCC Consumer and Governmental Affairs Bureau said in a public notice . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会今天表示，将创建一个自动电话缓解记分卡，以评估电话公司拦截非法垃圾电话的有效性。记分卡可以包括呼叫拦截统计数据以及客户投诉和执法行动的数据。 FCC 表示，记分卡可以按数字、字母等级对提供商进行评级，或者将提供商分为低风险、中风险或高风险。 FCC 消费者和政府事务局在一份公告中表示：“记分卡将向公众提供对语音服务提供商保护消费者免受非法机器人电话侵害的努力有效性的评估，从而赋予消费者权力，并鼓励提供商继续打击非法机器人电话。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The FCC's initiative to create a scorecard for phone companies highlights a commitment to accountability in the fight against illegal robocalls. This effort to bring transparency and measurable standards to the industry echoes the call to 'act justly,' ensuring that companies are held to account for their role in protecting consumers from unwanted and...
reflection.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）推出电话公司记分卡的举措，凸显了在打击非法机器人电话方面对问责制的承诺。这项旨在为行业带来透明度和可衡量标准的努力，呼应了‘秉公行义’的呼召，确保公司对其在保护消费者免受不请自来和欺诈电话方面所扮演的角色负责。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuring
title.zh: Uber因重大重组裁员逾3000人

summary.en: Uber is cutting over 3,000 jobs globally as part of a major restructuring aimed at simplifying operations, reducing management layers, and refocusing spending on its core business. This move brings staffing levels back to those seen in 2021 and is intended to position the company for future opportunities.
summary.zh: 优步（Uber）正进行重大重组，在全球范围内裁员超过3000人，旨在简化运营、减少管理层级，并将支出重新聚焦于核心业务。此次裁员将员工数量降至2021年的水平，旨在使公司为未来的机遇做好准备。

body.en:
Uber is cutting more than 3,000 jobs worldwide as part of a major overhaul designed to shrink management layers and refocus spending on its core business.

The cuts amount to roughly 10% of its global workforce, bringing staffing back to levels last seen in 2021.

Chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi told staff in a company email that the taxi and delivery firm had expanded quickly but accumulated too many layers and small teams that slowed decision‑making.

He said the reductions would put Uber, which has its global head office in San Francisco, US, in a better position for its "biggest opportunities ahead of us".

The move marks one of Uber's largest restructurings in years and signals a shift towards a leaner operating model.

Shares rose nearly 2% after the announcement, with investors appearing to welcome the proposals.

Cuts affect both managers and non-managers, and Uber said it plans to fold many of its smallest teams into larger groups, however, the firm has not confirmed the locations most affected by job cuts.

Such changes are intended to make Uber "simpler" and "faster," while freeing up money to reinvest in areas it considers central to its future , Khosrowshahi said.

The restructuring comes as Uber steps up investment in autonomous vehicle partnerships and expands its ride‑hailing, delivery, and robotaxi operations .

Uber is also tightening up its office strategy, asking nearly all employees to work in person at designated hubs and limiting remote roles to about 1%.

Unlike many large technology companies that have cut jobs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence (AI), Uber had avoided major reductions since the pandemic.

The latest changes bring its workforce back to just under 30,000 people, roughly where it stood before its most recent period of expansion.
body.zh: Uber 正在全球范围内裁员 3,000 多人，这是一项重大改革的一部分，旨在缩小管理层规模，并将支出重新集中在核心业务上。 此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的 10%，使员工人数恢复到 2021 年的水平。 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在公司电子邮件中告诉员工，这家出租车和送货公司扩张迅速，但积累了太多层级和小团队，导致决策速度变慢。 他表示，此次裁员将使全球总部位于美国旧金山的 Uber 处于更有利的位置，以应对“我们面前的最大机遇”。 此举标志着优步多年来最大的重组之一，并标志着其向更精简的运营模式的转变。 消息公布后，该公司股价上涨近 2%，投资者似乎对这些提议表示欢迎。 裁员影响到经理和非经理，Uber 表示计划将许多最小的团队合并为更大的团队，但该公司尚未确认受裁员影响最严重的地点。 科斯罗萨西表示，这些变化旨在让 Uber“更简单”、“更快”，同时释放资金，用于对其认为对其未来至关重要的领域进行再投资。 此次重组之际，优步加大了对自动驾驶汽车合作伙伴的投资，并扩大了其叫车、送货和自动驾驶出租车业务。 Uber 还收紧了其办公策略，要求几乎所有员工在指定中心亲自工作，并将远程角色限制在 1% 左右。 与许多在人工智能（AI）方面投入巨资而裁员的大型科技公司不同，自疫情大流行以来，Uber 避免了大幅裁员。 最新的变化使其员工人数恢复到不到 30,000 人，与最近一次扩张之前的水平大致相同。

reflection.en: In the face of significant restructuring and job cuts, the principle of 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters' (Colossians 3:23) offers a perspective. Even amidst corporate changes that impact many lives, the call remains to approach work with integrity and diligence, recognizing a higher purpose...
reflection.zh: 面对重大的重组和裁员，‘无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的’（歌罗西书3:23）的原则提供了一个视角。即使在影响许多人生活的企业变革中，我们仍被呼召以正直和勤奋的态度对待工作，认识到超越眼前环境的更高目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: On renewable energy, it’s time to debunk the ‘transition minerals’ narrative (commentary)
title.zh: 关于可再生能源，是时候揭穿“过渡性矿产”的说法了（评论）

summary.en: A commentary argues that the prevailing narrative, promoted by powerful institutions, that a green future necessitates a massive increase in 'critical mineral' mining is a 'lie'. It challenges the World Bank's claim that mineral production must increase by 500% by 2050, and the UNCTAD's projection of needing 250 new...
summary.zh: 一篇评论文章认为，由强大机构推广的、认为绿色未来需要大规模增加“关键矿产”开采的说法是一种“谎言”。文章质疑世界银行关于到2050年矿产生产需要增长500%的说法，以及联合国贸易和发展会议（UNCTAD）关于需要250个新矿山的预测，认为这些数字是误导性论述的一部分。

body.en: There is an insidious lie that has taken root in the energy transition narrative pushed by the world’s most powerful financial, political, and environmental institutions: we need to massively scale up “critical mineral” mining to secure a green future. The World Bank claims that production of key minerals will need to increase by 500% by 2050 for the energy transition. According to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), 250 new mines are needed to meet emissions targets (80 new copper mines, 70 new lithium mines, 70 new nickel mines, and 30 new cobalt mines). WWF says we need to dramatically increase the supply chain for a wide range of materials, including “transition minerals” as they’re also sometimes called. We are told that mineral extraction’s countless environmental harms — the streams contaminated by toxic runoff, the razed forests, the degraded air quality, the dying wildlife — are the necessary costs of the transition to renewable energy. Lithium pools in Salinas Grandes, Argentina. Image by Pedro J Pacheco via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0 DEED) But as we at the Oakland Institute show in a new report, “transition minerals” are misnamed. The vast majority are used in industries that are either unrelated — or in direct opposition — to the clean energy transition. This trend shows no signs of changing: artificial intelligence and heightened military spending are, in fact, increasing the demand for these minerals in industries driving ecological destruction. Scaling up mining as recommended by international organizations would…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在世界上最强大的金融、政治和环境机构推动的能源转型叙事中，有一个阴险的谎言：我们需要大规模扩大“关键矿产”开采，以确保绿色未来。世界银行声称，为了实现能源转型，到 2050 年，关键矿物的产量需要增加 500%。根据联合国贸易和发展会议（UNCTAD）的数据，需要新建250个矿山才能实现排放目标（80个新铜矿、70个新锂矿、70个新镍矿和30个新钴矿）。世界自然基金会表示，我们需要大幅增加各种材料的供应链，包括有时也被称为“过渡矿物”的供应链。我们被告知，矿物开采造成的无数环境危害——被有毒径流污染的溪流、被夷为平地的森林、恶化的空气质量、垂死的野生动物——是向可再生能源过渡的必要成本。阿根廷萨利纳斯格兰德斯的锂池。图片由 Pedro J Pacheco 提供，来自 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0 DEED） 但正如我们奥克兰研究所在一份新报告中所显示的那样，“过渡矿物”的命名是错误的。绝大多数用于与清洁能源转型无关或直接反对的行业。这一趋势没有任何改变的迹象：人工智能和军费开支的增加事实上正在增加行业对这些矿物的需求，从而导致生态破坏。按照国际组织的建议扩大采矿规模将……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Genesis account declares creation 'very good,' a testament to its inherent sufficiency and beauty. When we approach environmental challenges, we must discern whether our proposed solutions honor this foundational goodness or impose a narrative of scarcity and endless extraction. The call for massive mineral extraction, even for green energy, risks...
reflection.zh: 创世记宣告创造“甚好”，这是对其内在的充足和美丽的见证。当我们面对环境挑战时，必须辨别我们提出的解决方案是尊重这种根本性的美好，还是强加一种稀缺和无尽开采的叙事。即使是为了绿色能源而呼吁大规模开采矿产，也可能忽略了受造秩序中已有的深刻智慧和丰盛。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Planned Bolivia-Brazil highway threatens Chiquitania dry forest
title.zh: 拟议中的玻利维亚-巴西公路威胁奇基塔尼亚旱林

summary.en: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz has signed an agreement to initiate technical studies for a highway linking San Ignacio de Velasco in the Chiquitania region to the Brazilian state of Mato Grosso. Experts warn this project will lead to significant environmental damage, including deforestation and land-use changes for...
summary.zh: 玻利维亚总统罗德里戈·帕斯签署了一项协议，将启动连接奇基塔尼亚地区圣伊格纳西奥·德·韦拉斯科与巴西马托格罗索州的技术研究。专家警告称，该项目将导致严重的环境破坏，包括为农业开辟土地和森林砍伐，从而影响独特的奇基塔尼亚旱林生态系统。

body.en: On July 31, politicians and agribusiness leaders from Bolivia and Brazil gathered in the eastern Bolivian city of San Ignacio de Velasco. There, Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz signed an agreement to begin technical studies for a highway connecting San Ignacio de Velasco to Marfil, a point on the border with Brazil. A second section of the road will extend into Brazil toward the municipality of Vila Bela da Santíssima Trindade. Experts told Mongabay the project will cause severe environmental damage, driving deforestation and land-use change to make way for soy fields and cattle ranches on the Bolivian side. San Ignacio de Velasco lies in the heart of the Bolivian Chiquitania, a region of vast tropical dry forests. The municipality has 67,103 inhabitants, according to the 2024 census. On July 31, its small airfield briefly became an international airport as some 15 private planes landed there. Except for the Bolivian presidential plane, every aircraft belonged to Brazilian businesspeople and politicians. Among them was Eraí Maggi, known in Brazil as the “soy king.” Planes from Brazil arrive in San Ignacio de Velasco for the signing of the highway agreement. Image courtesy of the Bolivian government. San Ignacio de Velasco, which holds 3.4 million hectares (8.4 million acres) of Chiquitano forest, or 6.2% of Bolivia’s total forest cover, has become the country’s epicenter of deforestation, according to reporting by Nómadas magazine in 2025. The Institute for Socio-Economic Research (IISEC) at the Bolivian Catholic University (UCB) found that between 2017 and 2023, agricultural expansion…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 7月31日，来自玻利维亚和巴西的政治家和农业企业领导人聚集在玻利维亚东部城市圣伊格纳西奥德贝拉斯科。在那里，玻利维亚总统罗德里戈·帕斯签署了一项协议，开始对连接圣伊格纳西奥·德·贝拉斯科和巴西边境的马尔菲尔的高速公路进行技术研究。道路的第二段将延伸至巴西的 Vila Bela da Santíssima Trindade 市。专家告诉 Mongabay，该项目将造成严重的环境破坏，导致森林砍伐和土地利用变化，为玻利维亚一侧的大豆田和牧场让路。圣伊格纳西奥德贝拉斯科位于玻利维亚奇基塔尼亚的中心地带，这是一个拥有广阔热带干燥森林的地区。根据 2024 年人口普查，该市有 67,103 名居民。 7 月 31 日，大约 15 架私人飞机降落在该机场，该机场一度成为国际机场。除了玻利维亚总统专机外，所有飞机都属于巴西商人和政客。其中包括在巴西被称为“大豆之王”的 Eraí Maggi。来自巴西的飞机抵达圣伊格纳西奥德贝拉斯科，签署高速公路协议。图片由玻利维亚政府提供。根据 Nómadas 杂志 2025 年的报道，圣伊格纳西奥德贝拉斯科拥有 340 万公顷（840 万英亩）的 Chiquitano 森林，占玻利维亚森林总覆盖率的 6.2%，已成为该国森林砍伐的中心。玻利维亚天主教大学 (UCB) 社会经济研究所 (IISEC) 发现，2017 年至2023年，农业扩张……本文最初发表于Mongabay

reflection.en: The proposed highway through Bolivia's Chiquitania dry forest raises profound questions about human development and our role as stewards of God's creation. The earth and all its inhabitants belong to Yahweh, and our plans for progress must consider the delicate balance of ecosystems like the Chiquitania, which are vital parts of His design.
reflection.zh: 拟议中的玻利维亚奇基塔尼亚旱林公路项目，引发了关于人类发展以及我们作为雅伟创造管家角色的深刻问题。大地及其万物都属于雅伟，我们发展进步的计划必须考虑奇基塔尼亚这样脆弱的生态平衡，它们是祂设计中至关重要的部分。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: BoM forecasts strongest El Niño on record as research points to ‘alarming’ climate change influence
title.zh: 气象局预测史上最强厄尔尼诺现象，研究指出气候变化影响“令人震惊”

summary.en: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology forecasts that the El Niño weather event is already breaking heat records and is likely to surpass previous occurrences, with separate research suggesting climate change has significantly increased the likelihood of such extreme events.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚气象局预测，厄尔尼诺现象已打破高温记录，并可能超过以往的事件，而独立研究表明气候变化已大大增加了此类极端事件发生的可能性。

body.en: Bureau of Meteorology suggests El Niño has already broken records, with Pacific ocean temperature change exceeding 2C in six months Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here The growing El Niño weather phenomenon to Australia’s east is already breaking heat records, with forecasts showing it will likely easily surpass previous events, according to Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology, as seperate research suggested climate change had greatly shortened the odds of the event hitting record extremes. On Thursday the UN’s weather agency said the event in the Pacific was continuing to strengthen and would probably persist until early 2027, warning it had the “potential to deliver a massive blow to communities and economies across the world”. Sign up to get climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s Clear Air column as a free newsletter Continue reading...
body.zh: 气象局表示，厄尔尼诺现象已经打破了记录，太平洋温度在六个月内变化超过 2 摄氏度 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 在这里注册气候与环境编辑 Adam Morton 的免费晴空通讯 澳大利亚东部不断增长的厄尔尼诺天气现象已经打破了高温记录，根据澳大利亚气象局的预测，它很可能会轻松超过之前的事件，因为单独的研究表明，气候变化大大缩短了该事件发生的几率记录极端情况。周四，联合国气象机构表示，太平洋地区的这一事件正在继续加强，可能会持续到 2027 年初，并警告称，该事件“有可能对世界各地的社区和经济造成巨大打击”。注册以获取气候与环境编辑 Adam Morton 的 Clear Air 专栏作为免费时事通讯 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Earth groans, not just from the immediate impacts of extreme weather like the record-breaking El Niño, but from the deeper distress caused by human activity. As we witness these escalating events, we are reminded of creation's vulnerability and its longing for renewal, a longing echoed in the Apostle Paul's words.
reflection.zh: 大地在呻吟，不仅是因为像创纪录的厄尔尼诺现象这样的极端天气造成的直接影响，更是因为人类活动带来的更深层痛苦。当我们目睹这些不断升级的事件时，我们被提醒了受造物的脆弱及其对更新的渴望，这种渴望在使徒保罗的话语中得到了呼应。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Repeal of U.S. Roadless Rule could threaten drinking water for 25 million people
title.zh: 撤销美国“禁区规则”可能威胁2500万人的饮用水

summary.en: A proposed rule by the Trump administration could rescind the 2001 Roadless Area Conservation Rule, which protects about 45 million acres of national forest from new roads and logging. This land is a crucial source of drinking water for approximately 25 million Americans, and the proposed change has drawn significant...
summary.zh: 特朗普政府提出的一项新规可能撤销2001年的“禁区保护规则”，该规则保护了约4500万英亩国家森林免受新道路建设和商业伐木的影响。这片土地是约2500万美国人的重要饮用水源，该拟议的变更已引起广泛批评。

body.en: The drinking water for about 25 million Americans starts in the backcountry of the national forests, on land where roads are few by design. A rule the Trump administration proposed last week could open that land to roads and logging. On Aug. 18, the U.S. Department of Agriculture filed a proposed rule to fully rescind the U.S. Forest Service’s 2001 Roadless Area Conservation Rule, which bars new road construction and commercial logging on about 45 million acres (18 million hectares) of national forest. It was published in the Federal Register on Aug. 20, opening a 30-day public comment period that closes at midnight on Sept. 21. The proposed rule has drawn widespread criticism among wildland firefighters, environmental organizations, lawmakers and scientists. Much of the debate has centered on logging and fire. But researchers say some of the largest costs run downstream, into the taps of people’s homes. Wilder Mountain Inventoried Roadless Area ,Green Mountain National Forest in Vermont. Photo courtesy of Zack Porter / Standing Trees. Forests work as natural filters. They intercept rain, slow runoff, and trap sediment before water reaches streams, rivers and reservoirs. Roads and logging can undo that work, casting off sediment that utility companies must clean and driving up treatment costs. A 2024 study in Forests found that forest roads contribute up to 90 percent of sediment loads in streams and are “seriously disrupting the safety and stability of watersheds.” A study published in July in PLOS Water estimated that about 25 million Americans draw…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 约 2500 万美国人的饮用水源自国家森林的偏远地区，那里的道路本来就很少。特朗普政府上周提出的一项规则可能会开放这片土地用于道路和伐木。 8 月 18 日，美国农业部提交了一项拟议规则，要求全面废除美国林务局 2001 年的无路地区保护规则，该规则禁止在约 4500 万英亩（1800 万公顷）的国家森林上修建新道路和进行商业采伐。该规定于 8 月 20 日在《联邦公报》上发表，开启了为期 30 天的公众意见征询期，该征求意见期于 9 月 21 日午夜结束。拟议的规则引起了荒地消防员、环保组织、立法者和科学家的广泛批评。大部分争论都集中在伐木和火灾上。但研究人员表示，一些最大的成本流向下游，进入人们家中的水龙头。怀尔德山库存无路地区，佛蒙特州绿山国家森林。照片由 Zack Porter / Standing Trees 提供。森林起到天然过滤器的作用。它们拦截雨水，减缓径流，并在水到达溪流、河流和水库之前捕获沉积物。道路和伐木可以抵消这项工作，清除公用事业公司必须清理的沉积物，并增加处理成本。 《森林》杂志 2024 年的一项研究发现，森林道路占溪流中 90% 的沉积物负荷，“严重破坏了流域的安全和稳定”。 7 月在 PLOS Water 上发表的一项研究估计，大约有 2500 万美国人画画……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The proposed repeal of the Roadless Rule raises concerns about the protection of natural resources vital for human life, such as the drinking water for 25 million Americans. This situation calls us to remember that all the Earth and its bounty are ultimately Yahweh's, and we are called to be faithful stewards of His creation.
reflection.zh: 拟议中的“禁区规则”撤销引发了对保护对人类生命至关重要的自然资源的担忧，例如2500万美国人的饮用水。这种情况提醒我们，雅伟拥有全地及其一切丰盛，我们被呼召成为祂创造物忠实的管家。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Invasive tropical mosquito found breeding in east London
title.zh: 入侵性热带蚊子在伦敦东部繁殖

summary.en: An invasive mosquito species, Aedes aegypti, capable of transmitting tropical diseases like Zika and dengue, has been found breeding in homes in east London. Experts attribute this to the warming climate, which they believe will lead to more incursions of such mosquitoes into the UK. This marks the first time this...
summary.zh: 一种能够传播寨卡病毒和登革热等热带疾病的入侵性蚊子（埃及伊蚊）已在伦敦东部的家庭中被发现繁殖。专家认为，气候变暖将导致此类蚊子更多地侵入英国。这是该物种首次在英国被发现繁殖。

body.en: Climate crisis could increase incursions of Aedes aegypti, which can transmit Zika virus and dengue, experts say An invasive mosquito capable of transmitting tropical diseases has been found breeding in homes in east London, with experts warning that the rapidly warming climate will lead to greater “incursions of invasive mosquitoes”. This is the first time the species has been identified breeding in the UK and the fourth time it has been detected. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，气候危机可能会增加埃及伊蚊的入侵，埃及伊蚊可以传播寨卡病毒和登革热。在伦敦东部的住宅中发现了一种能够传播热带疾病的入侵性蚊子，专家警告说，迅速变暖的气候将导致更多的“入侵性蚊子入侵”。这是该物种首次在英国被发现繁殖，也是第四次被发现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Apostle Paul wrote that all of creation groans, awaiting its redemption. The presence of Aedes aegypti in London, a sign of our changing climate, echoes this groaning. It calls us to consider our stewardship of the earth and the unintended consequences of our actions on the natural world.
reflection.zh: 使徒保罗写道，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦，直到如今。埃及伊蚊出现在伦敦，这是我们气候变化的迹象，呼应了万物的叹息。这促使我们反思我们对大地的管理责任，以及我们行为对自然界造成的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: The plastic waste overtaking New York – and the people trying to curb it
title.zh: 纽约被塑料垃圾吞噬——以及试图遏制它的人们

summary.en: Photographer Bryan Anselm spent months documenting spaces in New York and Quebec overwhelmed by plastic waste, and the efforts of individuals and groups to reduce it. In New York City, discarded plastic is highly visible, with clear recycling bags showing contents and lightweight waste spilling from bins, scattering...
summary.zh: 摄影师布莱恩·安塞尔姆花了数月时间，拍摄了纽约和魁北克被塑料垃圾淹没的空间，以及个人和团体为减少垃圾所做的努力。在纽约市，被丢弃的塑料随处可见，透明的回收袋展示着里面的物品，轻质垃圾从垃圾箱中溢出，散落在人行道上，堆积在排水沟里，成为城市景观中普遍存在的一部分。

body.en: From New York to Quebec, photographer Bryan Anselm spent months capturing spaces overrun with plastic and the actions individuals and groups are taking to reduce waste In New York City, the plastic we discard has a way of remaining in plain sight. There are few alleys to hide residents’ refuse, and the clear recycling bags leave their contents on full display. In a city built on a dense grid, lightweight wrappers, bags and bottles spill from overflowing bins and skitter down sidewalks, collecting in gutters and corners before the wind carries them on. All that plastic is a layer of the urban landscape, as familiar as subway grates and fire escapes, revealing a messy and unflattering aspect of city life. “Garbage is not what we cast out, but the prime locus of meaning in our lives,” the character Nick Shay says in Don DeLillo’s Underworld. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从纽约到魁北克，摄影师 Bryan Anselm 花了几个月的时间捕捉塑料泛滥的空间以及个人和团体为减少浪费而采取的行动。在纽约市，我们丢弃的塑料以某种方式留在人们的视线中。几乎没有小巷可以藏住居民的垃圾，透明的回收袋将里面的物品展示得一清二楚。在一座建立在密集网格上的城市中，轻质包装纸、袋子和瓶子从满溢的垃圾箱中溢出，沿着人行道滑落，在风吹走之前聚集在排水沟和角落里。所有这些塑料都是城市景观的一层，就像地铁格栅和防火梯一样熟悉，揭示了城市生活混乱和不讨人喜欢的一面。 “垃圾不是我们扔掉的东西，而是我们生活的主要意义所在，”唐·德里罗的《黑社会》中的角色尼克·谢伊说道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sheer volume of plastic waste described in New York City is a stark reminder of humanity's impact on the environment. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'work it and take care of it,' a mandate to steward the earth responsibly. May we be inspired by the individuals and groups working to curb this pollution, reflecting a commitment to the care of creation.
reflection.zh: 纽约市塑料垃圾的惊人数量，是对人类对环境影响的严峻提醒。创世记2:15呼吁我们“耕耘和看守”，这是负责任地管理大地的使命。愿我们受到那些致力于遏制污染的个人和团体的启发，体现出对受造之物的关怀。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: A Surge of Marine Heat Waves Threatens to Scramble Ocean Life
title.zh: 海洋热浪激增，威胁要扰乱海洋生物

summary.en: Record-breaking marine heat waves, driven by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, are affecting oceans globally and severely disrupting marine life. Evidence suggests these events could cause long-lasting damage both on land and at sea. For example, an unusually large bloom of common octopuses has appeared off...
summary.zh: 受气候变化和不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，创纪录的海浪热浪正在席卷全球海洋，并对海洋生物造成严重破坏。越来越多的证据表明，这些事件可能对陆地和海洋都造成严重且持久的损害。例如，英国海岸出现了有史以来规模最大的普通章鱼幼体聚集现象，这与异常温暖的海水有关。

body.en:
Fueled by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, record-setting marine heat waves are gripping oceans worldwide and playing havoc with sea life. Mounting evidence from recent events suggests the damage could be severe and long-lasting, both onshore and off.

The common octopus is a warm water species that usually lives in the temperate waters of the Mediterranean. But last year, octopus larvae hitchhiked across the English Channel attached to plankton, resulting in an octopus bloom off England’s coast. This year, the bloom is the largest it’s been in 75 years.

Normally, octopus larvae that drift into cold waters die. But this year’s bloom, experts say, is the result of an unusually intense marine heat wave off of Devon and Cornwall, which raised water temperatures up to 9 degrees F above normal.

The change in species has been a boon for local fishers selling octopus into the lucrative European export market. (Octopus landings along the U.K.’s southwest coast were roughly 7,700 percent higher than usual in 2025.) And while the invasion has slashed the catch of scallops, lobster, and crab, it has boosted numbers of seals, conger eels, and dolphins, which eat octopus. The warming, in combination with abundant prey, has also drawn bluefin tuna and sharks to British waters for the first time in decades.

“It has completely shaken up the food chain,” said Bryce Stewart, a senior research fellow at the UK’s Marine Biological Association, which has been studying the phenomenon. While this kind of bloom has happened here before, he said, this one is different. During past surges, the return of cold water killed off the octopuses. This time, the octopuses aren’t dying. They’re reproducing.

Globally, marine heat waves — prolonged periods of unusually warm water — are becoming more common, more intense, longer lasting, and more widespread, experts say . This year, ocean heat is unusually severe, setting new temperature records . According to Global Climate Risks, a nonprofit created by scientists to publicize the effects of climate change, an estimated 82 percent of the world’s oceans are currently experiencing marine heat waves. Evidence from recent hot spells suggests the impacts on sea life could be profound and long-lasting.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

Ocean fevers can rearrange marine ecosystems, drive fish to move into deeper, colder layers of the sea, trigger coral bleaching, and cause widespread marine die-offs. They can increase the severity and number of algal blooms, which harm fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and birds. And they can cause extreme weather events, like tropical storms and hurricanes, and upend fishing and tourism.

To officially be called a heat wave, temperatures...
body.zh: 在气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧的推动下，创纪录的海洋热浪正在席卷全球海洋，对海洋生物造成严重破坏。最近发生的事件中越来越多的证据表明，无论是陆上还是海上，损害都可能是严重且持久的。 普通章鱼是温水物种，通常生活在地中海温带水域。但去年，章鱼幼虫附着在浮游生物上，搭便车穿越英吉利海峡，导致英格兰海岸出现章鱼大量繁​​殖。今年的花期是 75 年来规模最大的一次。 通常情况下，章鱼幼虫漂入冷水后就会死亡。但专家表示，今年的水华是德文郡和康沃尔郡异常强烈的海洋热浪造成的，导致水温比正常水平高出 9 华氏度。 物种的变化对于将章鱼销往利润丰厚的欧洲出口市场的当地渔民来说是一个福音。 （2025 年，英国西南海岸的章鱼登陆量比平时增加了大约 7,700%。）虽然入侵减少了扇贝、龙虾和螃蟹的捕获量，但以章鱼为食的海豹、海鳗和海豚的数量却增加了。气候变暖加上丰富的猎物，几十年来首次将蓝鳍金枪鱼和鲨鱼吸引到英国水域。 “它彻底撼动了食物链，”一直在研究这一现象的英国海洋生物协会高级研究员布莱斯·斯图尔特说。他说，虽然以前这里也发生过这种花，但这次不同。在过去的海潮中，冷水的回归导致章鱼死亡。这一次，章鱼没有死。他们正在繁殖。 专家表示，在全球范围内，海洋热浪（长时间异常温暖的海水）正变得更加常见、更加强烈、持续时间更长、范围更广。今年，海洋高温异常严重，创下了新的气温记录。据科学家创建、旨在宣传气候变化影响的非营利组织“全球气候风险”估计，目前世界上 82% 的海洋正在经历海洋热浪。最近的高温天气的证据表明，这对海洋生物的影响可能是深远而持久的。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 海洋热可以重新安排海洋生态系统，促使鱼类进入更深、更冷的海层，引发珊瑚白化，并导致广泛的海洋死亡。它们会增加藻华的严重程度和数量，从而危害鱼类、贝类、海洋哺乳动物和鸟类。它们还可能引发热带风暴和飓风等极端天气事件，并颠覆渔业和旅游业。 正式称为热浪，温度...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep sigh, and Romans 8 echoes this, describing all of creation groaning as in labor pains. We see this groaning in the oceans, where rising temperatures disrupt ancient ecosystems and lead to unexpected blooms, like the octopus surge off England's coast. It is a reminder that the natural world, in its current state,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾提到受造界的深沉叹息，罗马书第八章也呼应了这一点，将万物描述为一同叹息，如同经历生产之苦。我们在海洋中看到了这种叹息，不断升高的温度扰乱了古老的生态系统，并导致了意想不到的生物爆发，例如英国海岸的章鱼激增。这提醒我们，自然界在其现状下，也承载着影响所有生命的堕落的痕迹。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: I camped in one of Britain’s last remaining rainforests
title.zh: 我在英国最后一片雨林之一露营

summary.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest on the edge of Dartmoor, the subject of years of conservation efforts, has now opened to the public with a sustainable campsite. The author describes their experience camping near this delicate ecosystem, known as Atlantic woodland.
summary.zh: 位于德文郡达特穆尔边缘的一小片温带雨林，经过多年的保育工作，现已开放并设有一个可持续露营地。作者描述了在这一脆弱生态系统——被称为大西洋林地——附近露营的经历。

body.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest lies on the edge of Dartmoor, and following years of conservation work, its owners have now opened up a sustainable campsite next to this fragile ecosystem Mist blankets the valley as I wheel my camping gear down the small hill towards a clearing ringed by trees and shrubs. A picnic bench sits at its edge, angled towards the reason why I’m here: one of the last remaining fragments of temperate rainforest in Britain. I’m pitching my tent at Wray Valley Camping, a low-impact site on Dartmoor’s eastern edge between Lustleigh and Moretonhampstead, where I’ll spend five days on one of the site’s “nearly wild” pitches. Also known as Atlantic woodland, temperate rainforests depend on a rare combination of high humidity, rainfall and consistently mild coastal temperatures where the sea moderates the climate. They once stretched from the western Highlands of Scotland down to Cornwall, covering 20% of the UK , and sheltering rare and delicate lichens and plants. Today more than 95% of our temperate rainforest cover is gone, but Devon’s near-constant dampness and its exposure to the Atlantic make it one of the last strongholds for this rare habitat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 达特穆尔边缘有一片温带雨林，经过多年的保护工作，它的主人现在在这个脆弱的生态系统旁边开辟了一个可持续的露营地。当我推着露营装备沿着小山坡走向一片树木和灌木环绕的空地时，薄雾笼罩着整个山谷。一条野餐长凳坐落在它的边缘，与我来这里的原因成一定角度：英国仅存的温带雨林碎片之一。我正在雷谷露营地搭帐篷，这是达特穆尔东部边缘勒斯特利和莫顿汉普斯特德之间一个影响较小的营地，我将在该营地“近乎荒野”的营地之一待上五天。温带雨林也被称为大西洋林地，依赖于高湿度、降雨量和持续温和的沿海温度（海洋调节气候）的罕见组合。它们曾经从苏格兰西部高地一直延伸到康沃尔郡，覆盖了英国20%的面积，并庇护着稀有而娇嫩的地衣和植物。如今，超过 95% 的温带雨林覆盖面已经消失，但德文郡几乎持续潮湿且暴露在大西洋中，使其成为这一稀有栖息地的最后据点之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author's experience in Britain's dwindling temperate rainforest highlights the preciousness of creation. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning, awaiting its redemption (Romans 8:22). This fragile ecosystem, carefully tended, offers a glimpse of what Yahweh intends for all of nature.
reflection.zh: 作者在英国日益稀少的温带雨林中的经历，凸显了受造界的宝贵。使徒保罗提到，万物都在一同叹息，等候得赎（罗马书 8:22）。这片精心呵护的脆弱生态系统，让我们得以一窥雅伟对万物的心意。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This divine ownership calls us to care for creation, not exploit it for short-term gain, especially when it impacts...
reflection.zh: Saraji 煤矿获批延期至 2055 年，并将继续清除重要栖息地，这引发了关于我们如何管理地球的深刻问题。《诗篇》24:1 提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属雅伟”。这种神圣的所有权呼吁我们爱护受造物，而不是为了短期利益而剥削它，尤其是在影响到脆弱的生态系统和物种时。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

title.en: Data Centers are Helping Fuel a U.S. Battery Boom
title.zh: 数据中心正助力美国电池产业蓬勃发展

summary.en: Tech companies are facing criticism for powering new data centers with polluting gas generators. However, energy industry data reveals that alongside natural gas infrastructure, these firms are also investing heavily in battery storage solutions across the U.S.
summary.zh: 科技公司因使用污染性的燃气发电机为新建数据中心供电而面临批评。然而，能源行业数据显示，除了建设天然气基础设施外，这些公司还在美国各地大力投资电池储能解决方案。

body.en:
Across the U.S., tech companies have courted backlash for using polluting gas generators to power massive new data centers. But energy industry data shows that in addition to building out natural gas, firms are adding huge amounts of battery storage.

The energy demands of data centers are so great that large projects may need approval from regulators before connecting to the power grid. But instead of waiting for that approval, tech companies keen to build the infrastructure for A.I. are often building gas generators on site. By one estimate , more than 100 gigawatts of onsite gas power, the rough equivalent of 100 large gas power plants, is planned for data centers across the U.S.

To take full advantage of those gas generators, some companies are installing large lithium-ion batteries alongside, according to a new report from the Solar Energy Industries Association and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. Batteries are also being employed in tandem with renewable energy.

The report finds that data centers accounted for 5 of the nearly 31 gigawatt-hours of battery capacity installed nationally in the first half of this year. Further, data centers accounted for 75 percent of the capacity installed at commercial or industrial sites. Looking ahead, analysts project that data center demand for batteries will grow fivefold by the end of this decade.

In some places, the A.I. boom is also spurring installations of home batteries, as data centers obtain permission to connect to the grid by funding the installation of batteries in nearby homes. Under such programs, homeowners agree to discharge their batteries to the grid as needed to meet spikes in demand. Analysts say that public outcry over the data center boom may push companies to fund home battery installations.

In a similar vein, some companies are looking to meet the energy needs of data centers by providing rooftop solar to surrounding households or paying to weatherize homes to curb power demand from heating and cooling.

New polling from the Yale Program on Climate Change Communication finds that 56 percent of Americans would oppose a new data center in their community, while just 15 percent would approve of one. At the same time, 73 percent of Americans support requiring new data centers to offset their electricity use by installing rooftop solar or weatherizing nearby homes.

In a recent interview with Yale Environment 360 , former Energy Department official Jigar Shah said that it may ultimately be cheaper for tech companies to weatherize homes than to install gas turbines on site, to say nothing of the impact on public opinion. “At the end of the day, these [companies] need public permission,” he said. He added, “Figuring out how to gain that permission I think is also something the data...
body.zh: 在美国各地，科技公司因使用污染气体发电机为大型新数据中心供电而招致强烈反对。但能源行业数据显示，除了建设天然气外，企业还增加了大量的电池存储。 数据中心的能源需求非常大，大型项目可能需要获得监管机构的批准才能连接到电网。但科技公司并没有等待批准，而是热衷于为人工智能建设基础设施。通常在现场建造气体发生器。据估计，美国各地的数据中心计划使用超过 100 吉瓦的现场天然气发电，相当于 100 座大型天然气发电厂。 根据太阳能产业协会和 Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 的一份新报告，为了充分利用这些气体发生器，一些公司正在同时安装大型锂离子电池。电池也与可再生能源一起使用。 报告发现，今年上半年全国安装的近31吉瓦时电池容量中，数据中心占了5个。此外，数据中心占商业或工业场所安装容量的 75%。展望未来，分析师预计，到本十年末，数据中心对电池的需求将增长五倍。 在某些地方，A.I.随着数据中心通过资助附近家庭安装电池获得连接电网的许可，热潮还刺激了家用电池的安装。根据此类计划，房主同意根据需要将电池放电到电网，以满足需求高峰。分析师表示，公众对数据中心繁荣的强烈抗议可能会促使公司为家用电池安装提供资金。 同样，一些公司希望通过向周围家庭提供屋顶太阳能或付费对房屋进行防风雨以抑制供暖和制冷的电力需求来满足数据中心的能源需求。 耶鲁大学气候变化交流项目的最新民意调查发现，56% 的美国人反对在他们的社区建立新的数据中心，而只有 15% 的人赞成建立一个数据中心。与此同时，73% 的美国人支持要求新建数据中心，通过安装屋顶太阳能或对附近房屋进行防风雨处理来抵消用电量。 在最近接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，前能源部官员 Jigar Shah 表示，对于科技公司来说，对房屋进行防风雨改造最终可能比在现场安装燃气轮机更便宜，更不用说对公众舆论的影响了。 “归根结底，这些[公司]需要公众许可，”他说。他补充道，“我认为弄清楚如何获得许可也是数据的一部分......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers, fueled by immense energy demands, presents a complex picture. While the use of gas generators raises environmental concerns, the simultaneous investment in battery storage shows a dual approach to powering this new technological frontier. It calls us to consider how our innovations impact the world God declared 'very good,'...
reflection.zh: 数据中心因巨大的能源需求而迅速增长，这呈现出一幅复杂的图景。虽然使用燃气发电机引发了环境担忧，但同时投资电池储能则显示出为这一新技术前沿供电的双重方法。这促使我们思考，我们的创新如何影响雅伟宣告为“甚好”的世界，并敦促我们负责任地管理。

title.en: ‘Too Much Sugar’ Review: Robert Greene Continues Pushing Art as Therapy to New Heights
title.zh: 《糖太多》评论：罗伯特·格林继续将艺术作为疗法推向新高度

summary.en: Venice: This hybrid documentary about a self-aggrandizing Missouri man becomes an exploration of how the other people in his life are just as worthy of cinematic treatments.
summary.zh: 威尼斯：这部关于一个自命不凡的密苏里州男人的混合纪录片，成为了一次对生活中其他人同样值得电影关注的探索。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

That every person is the protagonist of their own life ranks among a class of truisms whose veracity is so indisputable that it scarcely seems necessary to interrogate. But that’s just what Robert Greene does in “ Too Much Sugar .” This hybrid documentary represents the director’s most audacious attempt to rethink the interplay between reality and art. His portrait of Ryan “Holli-wood” Holliger, a Missouri man using the tools of cinema to tell his own story, offers a hopeful yet honest assessment of the medium’s ability to transform the world.

The slippery line between fiction and non-fiction has always been Greene’s primary subject. His last film , 2021’s “Procession,” took a step further by concretizing a connection between art and therapy that frequently underlay the director’s work. In partnership with registered drama therapist Monica Phinney, who also participated in the production of “Too Much Sugar,” Greene set up controlled experiments to validate the healing properties of giving survivors of sexual assault the ability to reimagine their trauma as cinematic scenes. Related Stories Telluride 2026: New Movies Starring Andrew Scott, Julianne Moore, and John Malkovich Anchor This Year’s Likely Oscar Contenders ‘Bucking Fastard’ Review: The Mara Sisters Commit to Werner Herzog’s Wonderfully Weird Bit as Lovestruck Twins Who Move and Speak in Unison

But what structure Greene built carefully in “Procession,” he demolishes compellingly in “Too Much Sugar.” The clean demarcations between recreation and reality necessary to protect his previous subjects come crumbling down in the face of a larger-than-life figure like Ryan. This swaggering ball of machismo first came to Greene’s attention long before he ever started rolling cameras because both men had sons who played in the same youth basketball league. Greene hated Ryan when they were opponents, yet came to know and love him when the boisterous booster was on his side. Their affection and connection grew to the point where Ryan shared that he always wanted to make a grandiose movie about himself.

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 每个人都是自己生活的主角，这是一类不言而喻的真理，其真实性无可争议，几乎没有必要去质疑。但这正是罗伯特·格林在《糖太多》中所做的。这部混合纪录片代表了导演重新思考现实与​​艺术之间相互作用的最大胆尝试。他对瑞安·“霍利伍德”·霍利格（Ryan “Holli-wood” Holliger）的描绘是一位密苏里州人，利用电影工具讲述自己的故事，对媒体改变世界的能力提供了充满希望且诚实的评估。 小说与非小说之间的微妙界限一直是格林的主要主题。他的上一部电影 2021 年的《游行》更进一步，将艺术与治疗之间的联系具体化，而这往往是导演作品的基础。格林与注册戏剧治疗师莫妮卡·菲尼（也参与了《糖太多》的制作）合作，开展了对照实验，以验证性侵犯幸存者能够将自己的创伤重新想象成电影场景的治疗效果。相关故事《特柳赖德 2026》：由安德鲁·斯科特、朱丽安·摩尔和约翰·马尔科维奇主演的新电影主播今年可能的奥斯卡竞争者《Bucking Fastard》评论：玛拉姐妹致力于维尔纳·赫尔佐格饰演一对动作和说话都一致的热恋双胞胎的奇妙怪异部分 但格林在《游行》中精心构建的结构，却在《糖太多》中令人信服地拆除了。娱乐与现实之间的清晰界限对于保护他以前的拍摄对象来说是必要的，但在像瑞安这样具有传奇色彩的人物面前，这种界限就崩溃了。早在格林开始滚动摄像机之前，这种大男子主义的大男子主义就第一次引起了他的注意，因为两人的儿子都在同一个青年篮球联赛中打球。当他们是对手时，格林讨厌瑞安，但当这位喧闹的支持者站在他一边时，格林就认识并爱上了他。他们的感情和联系不断加深，瑞安表示他一直想拍一部关于自己的宏伟电影。 《糖太多》的早期标题卡概述了他们共同的艺术努力的核心张力。 “我同意帮助他，”格林写道，“我还要求记录他的真实生活。”电影制片人可以放纵瑞安最喜欢的一些……

reflection.en: Director Robert Greene's film, 'Too Much Sugar,' challenges the notion that only the 'protagonist' deserves the spotlight. By turning his lens on the supporting characters in one man's life, the film suggests that every individual possesses inherent dignity and a story worth telling. This echoes the profound truth that each person is created in the image of...
reflection.zh: 导演罗伯特·格林（Robert Greene）的电影《糖太多》（Too Much Sugar）挑战了只有“主角”才配得上聚光灯的观念。通过将镜头转向一个男人生活中的配角，这部电影表明每个人都拥有内在的尊严和一个值得讲述的故事。这呼应了一个深刻的真理：每个人都是照着雅伟的形象所造，值得被认可和尊重。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: ‘He was always a bit of a groundbreaker’: David Bowie enters a new dimension in ‘extended reality’ documentary
title.zh: 大卫·鲍伊进入“扩展现实”纪录片，开启新维度

summary.en: Hundreds of unseen images of the star feature at the Venice film festival, alongside virtual worlds exploring wildfires, wolves and the birth of stars. David Bowie shares the bill with starmen, firefighters and Walt Disney wolves at the 10th anniversary edition of Venice Immersive, the film festival’s pioneering...
summary.zh: 数百张这位明星的未公开照片在威尼斯电影节上展出，同时还有探索野火、狼群和恒星诞生的虚拟世界。大卫·鲍伊与星际人、消防员和迪士尼的狼一起亮相威尼斯沉浸式展的十周年庆典，这是电影节展示新叙事形式的先驱平台。由数百张前所未见的图像组成的3D纪录片《大卫·鲍伊：未见未闻》（David Bowie: Unseen...

body.en: Hundreds of unseen images of the star feature at the Venice film festival, alongside virtual worlds exploring wildfires, wolves and the birth of stars David Bowie shares the bill with starmen, firefighters and Walt Disney wolves at the 10th anniversary edition of Venice Immersive, the film festival’s pioneering showcase for new forms of storytelling. David Bowie: Unseen Unheard – a 3D documentary featuring hundreds of previously unseen images – is among 69 XR (extended reality) pieces playing at the event’s regular base on Lazzaretto Vecchio, a repurposed small island off the Venice Lido. Venice Immersive’s 10th birthday marks a milestone for an event which aims to provide a bridge between emergent technology and traditional narrative cinema. But the programme’s organisers are at pains to emphasise the ongoing scope of a project that has in recent years prompted similar sections at the Cannes, Geneva and Toronto film festivals. “This is not a retrospective,” declares the official festival blurb that welcomes guests to the island. It almost sounds like a warning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在威尼斯电影节10周年纪念版上，数百张看不见的威尼斯电影节明星特写图片，以及探索野火、狼和明星诞生的虚拟世界，大卫·鲍伊（ David Bowie ）与史塔门（ Starmen ）、消防员和沃尔特·迪斯尼（ Walt Disney ）狼分享了这项法案。威尼斯电影节是讲故事新形式的开创性展示。大卫·鲍伊（ David Bowie ） ：《闻所未闻》（ Unseen Unheard ）是一部3D纪录片，其中包含数百张以前看不到的图像，在威尼斯丽都（ Lido ）重新利用的小岛拉扎雷托·维奇奥（ Lazzaretto Vecchio ）的活动常规基地播放的69部XR （扩展现实）作品。威尼斯沉浸式的10岁生日是一个里程碑，旨在为新兴技术和传统叙事电影之间提供桥梁。但该计划的组织者正在努力强调一个项目的持续范围，该项目近年来在戛纳，日内瓦和多伦多电影节上引发了类似的部分。“这不是一个回顾展，”欢迎房客来到岛上的官方节日宣传语宣称。这几乎听起来像是一个警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary uses extended reality to explore vast themes, including the birth of stars. It reminds us that even as we explore human creativity and the cosmos through technology, the heavens themselves bear witness to a grandeur beyond our making. The Psalmist declares, "The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh," a truth that resonates whether viewed...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片运用扩展现实技术探索宏大的主题，包括恒星的诞生。它提醒我们，即使我们通过科技探索人类的创造力和宇宙，苍穹本身也见证着超越我们创造的宏伟。诗人宣告：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀”，这一真理无论通过镜头还是虚拟世界来观看，都回响在耳畔。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Streamers Were Scared of Trump and Wouldn’t Touch ‘Ask E. Jean’ — 5 Companies Are Teaming Up to Launch It on VOD
title.zh: 流媒体因特朗普而却步，但五家公司将联合推出《问E·简》点播影片

summary.en: Kinema, in partnership with several distributors, is releasing the documentary "Ask E. Jean," which focuses on advice columnist E. Jean Carroll and her defamation lawsuit against former President Trump, on video-on-demand platforms. This comes after mainstream distributors and streamers reportedly avoided the film due...
summary.zh: Kinema 与多家发行商合作，将在点播平台上推出纪录片《问E·简》，该片聚焦于意见专栏作家E·简·卡罗尔以及她与前总统特朗普之间的诽谤诉讼。此前，主流发行商和流媒体因担心与特朗普产生关联而回避了该片。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Since it premiered just over a year ago at last year’s Telluride Film Festival , mainstream distributors and streamers wouldn’t touch the documentary “ Ask E. Jean ,” which profiles advice columnist E. Jean Carroll amid her legal battle for defamation with President Trump. The film ‘s director Ivy Meeropol outwardly has blamed “The Trump Effect” for why buyers have “ghosted” her in getting the film released. So Meeropol has turned to some unconventional measures.

Over the last several months, “Ask E. Jean” has played in over 100 theaters across the country and sold out New York’s IFC Center, leading to a five-week engagement of the film in NY, as well as additional screenings in over 90 cities and 30 states. The audience demand has been there, even if other distributors have feared the commercial prospects of a political documentary or quite simply feared retribution from the Trump administration. Merger: ‘I Don’t Know How This Goes Through’ Venice’s ‘Burgundy’ Finds ‘The Truffle Hunters’ Directors Seduced by French Wine Country — Watch Exclusive Clip

But it has done so via the joint efforts of five different companies whom have all come together to help distribute it through more grassroots means: Impact Partners, which helped produce and finance “Ask E. Jean,” Theorem Media, an indie film distribution studio, took on the non theatrical and eventized theatrical distribution and organic social, Roco Films, which has led educational access for schools, colleges, and students, Abramorama , which handled the physical theatrical distribution, and Kinema , which is a platform that gives communities the means to host their own screenings and viewing parties . The companies don’t normally release films together, but this one was special.

Now, all five of those collaborators are again teaming up to finally bring “Ask E. Jean” to streaming on Kinema, where it has just launched today , September 2, for a premium video on demand window, IndieWire can reveal exclusively. The film is available for digital rental for $8.99 via Kinema, and it is continuing its theatrical run as well.

Christie Marchese of Kinema and Jenny McQuaile of Theorem Media told IndieWire that it was obvious no major streamer was going to step up anytime soon with a...

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘Led us down such a dark path’: documentary explores how 9/11 changed America
title.zh: “把我们引向如此黑暗的道路”：纪录片探讨 9/11 如何改变了美国

summary.en: The Netflix film 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' examines the lives of those profoundly affected by the 2001 terrorist attacks. As the US approaches a point where half its population was born after 9/11 or was too young to remember it, the film's director compares the event's distance to the bombing of Hiroshima,...
summary.zh: Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 一代》探讨了 2001 年恐怖袭击事件的深刻影响。随着美国即将迎来半数人口出生在 9/11 之后或对该事件记忆模糊的时刻，该片导演将此次事件的久远感比作广岛原子弹爆炸，凸显了其持久的影响。

body.en: In Netflix film Turning Point: Generation 9/11, the lives of people forever impacted by the terrorist attack in 2001 are explored Twenty-five years on, memory is giving way to history. Soon the US will cross the point where half its population were born after 11 September 2001 or were too young to remember the day that terrorists crashed planes into the World Trade Center in New York, the Pentagon in northern Virginia and a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. “When I do that math, I get to the bomb at Hiroshima – that’s how distant it is,” says Brian Knappenberger, 56, director of a new Netflix documentary, Turning Point: Generation 9/11 . “When we talk about the second world war, for our generation it seemed like a long time ago but, for the current generation of 20-year-olds, that’s how long ago it was.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 世代》中，探索了 2001 年遭受恐怖袭击永远影响的人们的生活。二十五年过去了，记忆正在让位于历史。很快，美国将有一半人口出生于 2001 年 9 月 11 日之后，或者年龄太小，不记得恐怖分子将飞机撞向纽约世贸中心、弗吉尼亚州北部五角大楼和宾夕法尼亚州尚克斯维尔田野的那一天。 56 岁的布莱恩·纳彭伯格 (Brian Knappenberger) 是 Netflix 一部新纪录片《转折点：第 9/11 代》的导演，他说：“当我计算时，我会想到广岛的原子弹——这就是它的距离。” “当我们谈论第二次世界大战时，对于我们这一代人来说，这似乎是很久以前的事了，但对于现在这一代 20 岁的人来说，那就是很久以前的事了。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' revisits the profound and lasting impact of the 9/11 attacks, which the director describes as leading America down a 'dark path.' This phrase captures the difficult truth that responding to evil with further conflict can perpetuate suffering and unintended consequences, a cycle that Scripture warns against....
reflection.zh: 纪录片《转折点：9/11 一代》重温了 9/11 袭击事件深远而持久的影响，导演称其将美国引向了一条“黑暗的道路”。这句话恰当地概括了一个严峻的事实：以冲突回应邪恶可能会延续苦难和产生意想不到的后果，这正是圣经所警示的循环。‘以善胜恶’（罗马书 12:21）的呼召，即使面对深重的创伤和损失，也促使我们寻求治愈与和解之路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: The Black Garden review – haunting study of growing up in war-torn Nagorno-Karabakh
title.zh: 《黑花园》评论——对在战火纷飞的纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫长大的孩子的凄美研究

summary.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict. After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless...
summary.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米扬的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔和阿沃两个十岁出头的男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地被残酷的冲突所伤害。苏联于1991年解体后，一场持续数十年的领土争端在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发，当地主要是亚美尼亚人口与阿塞拜疆军队进行了无数次军事战役的斗争。这部影片拍摄历时三年，于2023年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政...

body.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless military campaigns from the Azerbaijani army. Shot over the course of three eventful years, which culminated in the surrender of Nagorno-Karabakh’s separatist government in 2023 , Alexis Pazoumian’s haunting documentary harnesses the collective turmoil that dominated generations of Armenians. From the elderly to the very young, the community are united by an unwavering sense of pride, one that carries them through never-ending bloodshed and displacement. The film opens with the harrowing sight of a bombed-out school in the small village of Talish, where childlike innocence contrasts with wartime trauma. Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys, roam through the wreckage and scavenge for remains of past normalcy, like the scattered notebooks left behind by their former classmates. The threat of the enemy, however, is drilled into every aspect of their daily life. At school, they learn how to assemble guns, and at family gatherings, they join in songs that speak of heroic valour. That the children here – boys and girls – will grow up to become soldiers is a foregone conclusion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔 (Samvel) 和阿沃 (Avo) 这两个青春期男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地因残酷的冲突而受到创伤。 1991 年苏联解体后，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发了长达数十年的领土争端，该地区主要是亚美尼亚人，与阿塞拜疆军队的无数军事行动进行了斗争。亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 这部令人难忘的纪录片历时三年多的时间拍摄，最终导致纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政府于 2023 年投降，讲述了统治几代亚美尼亚人的集体动乱。从老年人到年幼的孩子，社区都以一种坚定不移的自豪感团结在一起，这种自豪感使他们经历了永无休止的流血和流离失所。影片以塔利什小村庄一所被炸毁的学校的悲惨景象开始，孩子般的纯真与战时的创伤形成鲜明对比。萨姆维尔和阿沃是两个青春期前的男孩，他们在废墟中漫步，寻找过去常态的遗迹，比如他们以前的同学留下的散落的笔记本。然而，敌人的威胁渗透到他们日常生活的方方面面。在学校，他们学习如何组装枪支，在家庭聚会上，他们一起唱颂英雄勇气的歌曲。这里的孩子们——男孩和女孩——长大后成为士兵已成定局。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "The Black Garden" brings to light the profound impact of war on children, focusing on Samvel and Avo. Their young lives are shaped by conflict, a stark reminder of the voiceless who bear the brunt of adult disputes. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute."...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《黑花园》揭示了战争对儿童的深远影响，聚焦于萨姆维尔和阿沃。他们年幼的生活被冲突所塑造，这鲜明地提醒我们那些承受着成人争端重担的无声者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者判定公正”。这部影片有力地证明了这一呼召，敦促我们铭记并倡导那些卷入全球冲突战火中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Isaac Mizrahi Documentary ‘Unzipped’ Is the Ultimate ’90s Fashion Portrait — Watch the Trailer
title.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》是终极的90年代时尚肖像——观看预告片

summary.en: Douglas Reeve's 1995 documentary follows Mizrahi into his 1994 fall collection. Access was helped amply by the fact that they were dating at the time.
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·里夫1995年的纪录片跟随米兹拉希进入他1994年的秋季系列。由于当时他们正在约会，因此获得了充分的便利。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Filmmaker Douglas Keeve’s 1995 documentary “ Unzipped ” follows fashion designer and eventual mogul Isaac Mizrahi, then the director’s boyfriend, into his fall 1994 collection. The ’90s-centric movie remains the ultimate portrait of New York’s high fashion world at the time, with guest appearances including Cindy Crawford, Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and Kate Moss. Plus, the film won the audience award at the 1995 Sundance Film Festival. Now, Janus Films is bringing the movie back to theaters courtesy of a new restoration. Watch the trailer below.

Here’s the synopsis courtesy of Janus Films: “Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait — sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock — transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs.” Related Stories ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ Viewed as Unreleasable by Warner Bros., Just Beat a Jacob Elordi and Ridley Scott Movie at the Box Office From Timothée Chalamet and Tom Cruise to Cynthia Erivo: It’s Time for Some Overdue Actors to Finally Win an Oscar

Charli XCX recently told Vogue : “Directed by Douglas Keeve, it follows Isaac Mizrahi as he gets ready for his New York Fashion Week collection. If you love fashion, you have to see this documentary. All the legends are there — Kate, Naomi, Christy — and even Galliano and Polly Mellen. But most importantly, the film perfectly captures the artist’s creative process: bursts of inspiration, self-doubt, vulnerability, and finally, triumph.”

Janus Films opens “Unzipped” on Friday, September 25 at Film Forum in New York City. Then, the film opens in Los Angeles at the Laemmle Royal and Glendale on Friday, October 9. A national rollout will follow. The Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive digitally restored the film.

reflection.en: The documentary 'Unzipped' offers a glimpse into the intense dedication and creative labor behind Isaac Mizrahi's 1994 fall fashion collection. It showcases the passion and effort poured into bringing a vision to life, reminding us that all work, whether in design or any other field, can be offered as a service to God.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》让我们得以一窥艾萨克·米兹拉希1994年秋季时装系列背后倾注的专注和创造性劳动。它展示了将一个愿景变为现实所付出的热情和努力，提醒我们，所有工作，无论是在设计领域还是其他任何领域，都可以作为对雅伟的服事。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Guardian-produced Gaza documentary from Oscar-winning Israeli directors of No Other Land to screen at Venice film festival
title.zh: Guardian制作的加沙纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演执导，将在威尼斯电影节上映

summary.zh: 由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔（与巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔共同执导《无他之地》）执导的《卫报》制作的加沙纪录片，将调查战争期间“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”，并将在威尼斯电影节首映。这部名为《NAZA》的电影由吉姆·威尔逊制作，乔纳森·格雷泽（《利益区域》团队）担任执行制片人，是今...

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。
